reports.description: I used  FTX Trading LTD began to use their platform to buy and sell cryptocurrencies on June 12th 2021. As I began to develop my trading skills I began to be profitableI would mainly trade and transfer assets between two the following two exchanges: https://www.hotbit.io/ & https://ftx.com/ Capital of approximately the equivalent of 4 million Thai baht was shared across these two main exchanges.I noticed that all of my assets that were being held within ftx.com has been sold into bitcoin, and had then immediately been withdrawn to a single 3rd party‚Äôs bitcoin address. At the time of the attack my iOS device was actively logged into the FTX Pro application, using my cellular internet connection for the SIM number +66970485630 which is provided by https://truemoveh.truecorp.co.th/?ln=en I immediately informed ftx.com via their telegram support group https://t.me/FTX_Official Staff froze my account which included disabling withdrawals. This was important because approximately 2000 USD was still inside the account after the attack. A RAT perhaps in combination with a keylogger, could have been used to learn my login password and my withdrawal password for any or all of the websites which I frequently used. The value of the assets which were removed from my ftx.com account at the time of the attack was 91,292 USD. All were converted into Bitcoin by the attacker before being withdrawn to the attacker‚Äôs bitcoin address bc1qmnnxz2qprevme3hl8atjzfx62535fngkf284u2. Attacker then moved the bulk of the bitcoin to a second wallet address bc1qsj0s2h4cdukez06j8addqessmlkfplcaf2as74 where it resides to this day.
